title: Lunar Contact
blurb: An Apollo portrait opens like a magazine spread. A bootprint leads into a three-frame lunar contact sheet.
inputs: Three photographs of the same subject, a place and a date.
beats: 0–3s / Pair one arresting photograph with a two-line serif title and a fine orange rule.
3–5.5s / Push into a photographic detail. Draw one precise annotation to what the viewer should notice.
5.5–8s / Pull back to three numbered exposures, then hold the final spread.

title: Offbeat
blurb: A two-word title falls out of step with a row of bars. A run of abrupt verbs resolves into a single phrase.
inputs: A short title and three to five punchy words. Works with type alone.
beats: 0–2.75s / Split a large title over two lines. Send a wave across a row of printed bars.
2.75–5.25s / Cut to vermilion. Swap one oversized verb on each half-second beat; vary serif and grotesk weights.
5.25–8s / Land on a cream end card. Bring the last word into register, then let the orbit carry the remaining rhythm.

title: One Take
blurb: A vintage movie camera breaks the edge of a printed title, then reappears inside the frames of a filmstrip.
inputs: One sharply cut-out object or a clear photo on a simple background.
beats: 0–2.9s / Set an oversized black and red title on textured paper. Let the object overlap the title zone.
2.9–5.55s / Turn the page to blue. Enlarge the same object, mark one feature and give it a short label.
5.55–8s / Pull the object into successive film frames. Stop on a legible end title.

title: Swatchbook
blurb: Five printed swatches fan across the table. A single selection turns the deck into a saved palette.
inputs: A product name, one interaction and a small set of colours or options.
beats: 0–3s / Introduce the product beside a fan of five material cards. Let the stagger travel through the deck.
3–5.65s / Straighten the cards into a picker. Move the cursor to one selection and lift it on contact.
5.65–8s / Fill the frame with the selected colour and reveal the complete saved palette as proportional strips.
